summaryZh: Ahmadi Lab 以患者为中心研究慢性肾病作为全身性疾病的机制，关注线粒体健康、微血管功能、体能表现与患者结局之间的联系，并探索改善日常功能和长期健康的干预。
researchQuestions: 线粒体和血管通路如何影响慢性肾病进展、患者结局及体能功能？
topics: 慢性肾病的全身性影响
methods: 游离线粒体DNA及多组学研究
药物和生活方式干预研究

evidence.quote: Ahmadi Lab Patient-oriented kidney research at UC San Diego.
We study chronic kidney disease as a systemic condition, focusing on the links between mitochondrial health, microvascular function, physical performance, and patient-centered outcomes.
Cell-free mitochondrial DNA, multiomics, metabolism, oxidative stress, and mitochondrial pathways in CKD.
Systemic microvascular assessment using non-invasive approaches
Pharmacologic and lifestyle approaches designed to improve daily function and long-term health.
